v.rationale: All three are functionally correct and behave identically under probes (unicode/% filenames download safely as attachments, hashed storage names, extra query param invalidates signature, expiry after 10 min, SVG rejected, client user_id ignored). Ranking therefore rests on idioms and tests. impl-3 is most idiomatic: FormRequest with the File rule builder, route-level ->can() authorization with a denyAsNotFound policy, non-fillable user_id, and the most thorough tests (assertDownload, data provider, public-disk privacy, real token). impl-2 is close: FormRequest and policy but Gate::authorize in controller, string rules, slightly thinner tests. impl-1 works but uses inline validation, a hand-rolled strict-equality ownership check instead of a policy, and mass-assignable user_id.
